verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's documented remote MCP server lets an agent explore schemas, tables, and columns and run read-only or read-write SQL through `query_rw`, all without a dashboard. Programmatic access also comes through the DuckDB CLI, SDKs, and a Postgres endpoint, and CLI/Python users can save credentials for session-less authentication. Governance is documented through read-only restriction for AI assistants, role-scoped Shares with include patterns, SaaS Mode, and Guides that hold metric definitions. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end agent workflow, and detailed documentation of headless service-token authentication and query auditing.
